format_version.description: Format version if applicable (e.g., "5.3.1" for CrossRef)

parsed_at.description: Timestamp when parsed into Hub format

unmapped_fields.description: Fields that were placed in 'extra' (for audit purposes)

origin.description: Origin identifies the source system or installation that supplied the record, independent of the serialization format.

source_uri.description: Source URI is the canonical API or public locator for the source record.

profile_fingerprint.description: Profile fingerprint identifies the exact immutable mapping contract used to parse this record. It is populated together with model_fingerprint.

model_fingerprint.description: Model fingerprint identifies the exact source-system schema snapshot to which the profile was bound.

SourceInfo.title: Source Info
SourceInfo.description: SourceInfo tracks the origin of a record for auditing and debugging.
